name: NURS 2175
title: Global Politics of Childbearing and Reproduction
description: Maternal health and reproductive issues on a global scale. Focused and sustained examination of the social, cultural, and political forces which organize childbirth and reproductive experiences. Emphasizes a critical exploration of the diversity of women’s childbirth and reproductive experiences and the past and current approaches to this care from a global perspective. CA 1. CA 4-INT.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
